snippet.title: Play Faster: Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing Play Faster, a minimalist precision platformer purpose-built for speedrunning. It features built-in tools to support that, like input display, a replay system, instant retries, and practice mode; as well as anti-cheat and anti-splice to best make sure it has fair competition and leaderboards. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4457560/Play_Faster/

#IGN #Gaming
